audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Kennen, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Kennen on both layers. The packet chart and the already-audited mirror (kennen__volibear) both give Kennen the middle of the lane and Volibear the two-item row: Level 1 Skill, Levels 2 through first item Kennen, 2+ items Volibear. The old row 6 (Kennen) also contradicted its own why text, which says Volibear is a drain-tank Kennen cannot burst.
audit.why: Kennen out-ranges every Volibear tool from level 2 (Thundering Shuriken, 950 range, 7s at rank 1) and Lightning Rush answers the run-down; Volibear only wins once he has the health to survive three marks.
audit.corrected: Row 0 Skill; rows 1-5 Kennen; row 6 Volibear on both layers, ratings realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Volibear's kill window with no mention of Slicing Maelstrom, and the first-item row claimed Volibear forces Kennen to fight.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is 120s flat, 550 range, and applies Mark of the Storm repeatedly — three marks stun, which is exactly what kills a Stormbringer dive. Volibear's genuine spike here is the two-item health pool, not level 6.
audit.corrected: phases[4..5].why and spikes[1] now sequence the leap after his E and R rather than into them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sky Splitter was implied to be an engage/interrupt tool and no real cooldowns appeared anywhere — the packet flags zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Riot's text gives Sky Splitter damage, a slow and a self-shield only if Volibear is inside the blast — no CC, so it cannot interrupt Slicing Maelstrom. Thundering Smash is the stun and it lands on the attack. Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 falling to 6s, and Mark of the Storm stuns on the third application.
audit.corrected: Sky Splitter slows and self-shields (in-blast only); walk up in the window after Lightning Rush; break off at two marks.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers and told the player to 'all-in when it's down' without naming which seconds.
audit.why: Lightning Rush 10/9/8/7/6s and Slicing Maelstrom 120s flat are the two windows that decide every commit.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns written with numbers and an explicit wait-then-act sequence.

edits.before: He kites + stuns — build MR, Q-stun when his E is down. Volibear wins by trading around Kennen's Lightning Rush and cashing the pattern: build MR and all-in off his E.
edits.after: He kites and stuns — three Mark of the Storm stacks lock you down. Build MR, walk up in the seconds after Lightning Rush, and never start the fight while Slicing Maelstrom is up.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. All-in when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Kennen Slicing Maelstrom: A storm around him that repeatedly damages + stuns via marks. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Lightning Rush (E): 10s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5 — his only escape, so wait for him to spend it before you Q. - Slicing Maelstrom (R): 120s flat — three Mark of the Storm stacks stun you, so never start the leap while it is up.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Kennen has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Thundering Shuriken is 950 range on a 7s cooldown — he pokes your walk-up and gives nothing back.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Kennen under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields you only if you stand in the blast, and it does not stun — it slows, so use it to catch him, not to interrupt.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Kennen down every time Lightning Rush is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard, but Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 and drops to 6s — walk up only in the seconds after he spends it.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Kennen under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables his tower on landing, but Slicing Maelstrom (120s) stacks three marks and stuns you mid-dive — leap only after his R.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Kennen to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky heals on the first hit, but his poke item reloads the zone — farm, build MR, and wait for the two-item swing.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Mark of the Storm procs stun you — disengage once you are on two stacks.

edits.before: Level 6 your R closes the gap and flips the all-in to you.
edits.after: Level 6 his Slicing Maelstrom out-damages your leap.

edits.before: Your R Stormbringer closes the gap and lets you all-in through his stun; time your engage after he's used E so he can't dash away from your Q root.
edits.after: Stormbringer closes the gap and disables his tower, but Slicing Maelstrom is 120s of stacking marks — engage after he spends E and R, never into both.

notes: The mirror listed flips for rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 and did not mention row 3 (Levels 4-5). I set row 3 to Kennen to match the packet chart and the existing whys[3] text, which already describes Kennen poking and stunning through that stage — flag for QA if the mirror's row 3 says otherwise. Volibear's E carries a 'projectile' derived flag that contradicts Riot's own text (a bolt summoned at a location); no Wind Wall claim written. Whether Slicing Maelstrom's ticks continue through Stormbringer's leap is not answerable from the kits and was not asserted.
